answer:
Gerald T. Whelan's birthplace is **Hastings, Nebraska**, which is located in **Saunders County**.

While some genealogical records (such as FamilySearch) have listed Adams County, this appears to be an error or outdated administrative designation. Geographically, Hastings has been the county seat of Saunders County for many years and remains so today.
